text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the turn of the year, Tamamo Cross becomes a senior racer. We kick off the new year with a customary shrine visit…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's lookin' about time, Trainer. This is the year… We're makin' it happen for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ever since my debut two years ago, I've been lyin' low and waitin' while I toughened up my body…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I'm done waitin'. I got plenty of power stored up, 'n it's cracklin' away inside!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I've gotta hit the turf and let this energy fly! Time to show 'em what White Lightnin' can do!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And then, I'll use all da winnin's to make my family happy. I'm gonna shower 'em in everything they ever wanted!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You 'n me, we're gonna make this a reality! Now let's get some prayers in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our hands pressed tightly together, the two of us pray for success at the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We finish up our shrine visit and take a stroll through town…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it'd be nice to send a li'l somethin' home now… Y'know, to start the year right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: How 'bout we splurge 'n get 'em a nice house!
choice_data_list: Our budget probably won't cover that…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh, too much? But I wanna send 'em somethin' fancy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Problem is, I'm bad at pickin' presents, let alone fancy-schmancy stuff…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do you think'd be good, Trainer? Could ya choose somethin' my folks back home'd like?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I'm tasked with finding a gift. I think the best present for Tamamo Cross's family would be…
choice_data_list: A photo that shows your growth.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Delicious snacks? Yeah… The little rascals back home'd be real excited about tryin' somethin' they've never had before.
choice_data_list: Let's head to the department store, then.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. They've got a whole floor of ritzy gift boxes, huh? The real bougie stuff… But what the heck, it's New Year's, am I right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we head to the delicatessen floor of the department store.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, they got samples out. Let's get some nibbles.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't even know how to describe this taste… It's so fancy I can't tell if it's delish or nasty. Still…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, there's a sugary kick to 'em! I feel like I just got charged with enough energy for three whole races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gourmet snacks' refined sweetness gives her an immediate energy boost. These snacks will probably be perfect for her younger siblings, given their playful ages.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Showing my growth? How's dat supposed to work?! You gonna tell me to stand on my tip-toes or somethin'?!
choice_data_list: No, I mean we should take a photo that shows how far you've come.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Oh, so that's what you meant. A pic to show my growth as a runner could cheer 'em up, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let's go find some place to snap pics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and I check out several places in search of the right backdrop for the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ooh, the student council office. I bet we can get a couple nice shots here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: How's this? I mean, when it comes down to gags, my zingers beat out Rudolf's puns any day of the week!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What are we doin' at a haunted house?! I-I'm comin' down with a bad case of jelly legs already…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But wait… I'm not the me I used to be… Okay, time to break out the pearly whites!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We take several progress shots here and there, and by the time we put the camera away, it looks like Tamamo Cross is feeling quite proud of herself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So like, somethin' you can only find in Tokyo? Makes sense. They've got all kinds of wacky stuff for tourists.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The squirts back home'll probably get a kick outta it. C'mon, let's go take a look-see.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: D-da heck is this?! A panda mask? It's so stinkin' cute…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They've got a whole kabuki mask set too. If mom wore this… yeah, that'd make anyone jump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After going on a spending spree, we put the various souvenirs together and send a package to Tamamo Cross's family. Having touched on so many interesting ideas, our perspective on things broadens.
